# Digital Pathway

> Digital Pathway is a marketing agency focused on real estate and home service businesses. The agency connects conversion-focused websites, SEO and AI search visibility, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and conversion measurement.

## Core services

- /services/web-design — Conversion-focused web design and development
- /services/seo — SEO, local search strategy, content structure, and AI search visibility
- /services/google-ads — High-intent paid search campaigns and landing-page alignment
- /services/meta-ads — Paid social strategy, creative, retargeting, and conversion paths

## Industries

- /industries/real-estate — Marketing for agents, teams, brokerages, developers, and property businesses
- /industries/home-services — Marketing for contractors and home service businesses

## Content standard

Digital Pathway does not publish fabricated reviews, performance statistics, awards, credentials, locations, or guarantees. Search rankings, lead volume, revenue outcomes, and AI citations are not guaranteed.

This file is provided as optional machine-readable documentation. It is not presented as a Google ranking factor and does not replace normal crawling, indexing, structured data, or useful HTML content.
